title: Inauguration Ceremony for Seventh Training Programme on Various Analytical Instruments and Techniques for Government Drugs Analyst
bodyHtml:
The Inaugural ceremony of the Seventh training program on analytical instruments was commenced with the lighting of lamp by IPC Scientists. The program was graced by the presence of chief gust Dr. A.K. Pradhan, DDC(I) CDSCO, North Zone, Ghaziabad. Total no. of 40 participants from 17 different states all over the country was registered for training program.
